column5: ★ 2026-08-05: the four board/panel defects recorded on 2026-08-05 are FIXED IN SOURCE against the frames; still `partial` because nothing was render-measured and the tablet/mobile tier is unbuilt. WHAT WAS FIXED. (1) PER-DIFFICULTY PALETTE. PlinkoGame.tsx now carries three ramps in PLINKO_BUCKET_RAMPS, each sampled bucket-by-bucket off its own frame: Easy (low) #90E3E7 #7DD4E7 #69C6E6 #57B8E6 #46ACE6 #349EE6 #2391E6 #1184E6 #0078E6 from 9069:6513; Medium #A1E03C #8ED639 #7ACD37 #67C334 #55BB31 #44B12F #34A72C #34A72C #1A9627 from 9095:5889; Hard (high) #E590F2 #DB85EE #D17CEB #C771E7 #BE68E3 #B45EE0 #AA55DC #A04CD9 #9744D5 from 9095:5332. Previously ONE ramp - the Easy one - was hardcoded and painted on all three, so Medium and Hard rendered the wrong colourway outright. (2) THE RAMP IS MIRRORED. Each array runs EDGE->CENTRE and getMultiplierSlotColor indexes it by distance from the centre bucket, so the row is symmetric exactly as all three frames draw it. The old getMultiplierSlotColors mapped t = index/(total-1) monotonically and colour-inverted the right half of every board; the comment asserting the frame was "NOT a symmetric center-out ramp" was itself the bug and is replaced - those nine stops were precisely the nine distinct colours of the mirrored HALF row. Resampling still works for the 8- and 12-row boards. Bucket chrome now matches too: flat fill instead of a vertical gradient, radius/border/foot held as the frame's ratios (4.565, 1.712 and 13.55 over 31.952 of slot height), inset bottom foot at rgba(0,0,0,0.2), the white 15% top highlight dropped (the frame has none), and text pinned to Green Coal 300 #001615 on every bucket rather than luminance-picked. (3) THREE BALL VARIANTS BUILT. 9137-10213/10215/10217 are flat 10px discs - confirmed from the exported SVGs, `<circle r="5">` with a single fill - at #56C7F3 Easy, #3BFF00 Medium, #DC4CE9 Hard. drawGame drew one r=7 orange-red radial gradient with a 14px glow and a white specular for all three; it now draws a flat r=5 disc keyed off riskLevel. Ball hues are NOT the bucket hues (the balls are more saturated), so they live in their own PLINKO_BALL_COLOR map. (4) AUTO PANEL. Label is the frame's "Number of Bets:", the field accepts 0, an infinity affordance sits at its trailing edge where the frame's 16x7 glyph is, and 0 now genuinely means unlimited - burstDrop runs to POSITIVE_INFINITY, placing one REAL playPlinko settlement per ball until stopped. The 25-ball cap is now understood as a RENDER budget: long and unlimited runs WAIT for headroom per tick instead of being trimmed, so the "Burst Trimmed" toast is gone. CTA relabelled "Bet" per 9104:6251. (5) PEGS, found while verifying the above and fixed with it. The peg SVGs export byte-identical from the Easy and Medium frames (9069:5872 vs 9095:5373), so pegs are NOT per-difficulty - the board's risk colour is carried entirely by the buckets and the ball. The frame draws a FLAT WHITE circle, r=3.42339 on a 34.234 column pitch, i.e. exactly 0.1 of the pitch. The code painted #EAF7FE (near-white with a blue tint) at a hardcoded r=3; it now paints #ffffff and derives the radius as pegSpacingX * 0.1 so the ratio holds at 8, 12 and 16 rows rather than being right at one row count. The sky-blue glow is KEPT: the frame's peg group contains a second ellipse ("Ellipse 38") that exports EMPTY, which is how a blur/glow effect layer comes back, so the frame does have a glow layer whose parameters could not be read - the existing rgba(86,199,243,0.30) stands in for it and is the one peg property still unverified. Board-shaping controls (currency, difficulty, rows, arrow shortcuts) now gate on `boardLocked` = activeBallCount > 0 OR an Auto run still queueing, because an unlimited run outlives any one screenful of balls and the board could otherwise be empty mid-run. ★ DELIBERATE DEVIATIONS, each a judgement call not an oversight: the CTA reads "Stop" while an Auto run is queueing (the frame draws no stop state; an unlimited autobet cannot ship without one); Auto defaults to 1 bet rather than the frame's drawn 0, because that 0 is a placeholder of the same class as the frame's "100" bet amount and "100.11 SKAI" balance - the code has always defaulted the bet to 0.10, not 100 - and defaulting a real-money autobet to unlimited is not a default anyone chose; and the POINTS/SKAI/sUSD row is kept though the frame draws a single SKAI field, since the panel is the only place to pick the settlement rail. ★ FRAMES DECLINED, NOT BUILT. 9104-6283 "Plinko Old" is the superseded rainbow board that the three Mode frames replace. 9003-83784 is a mis-assembled tablet whose details card reads "Crash  Skai Originals" over BLACKJACK art with Crash body copy and Blackjack community-wins rows; its sibling 9003-82836 covers the same 768 viewport and is the tablet of record. 9175-9939 "signals" is a loose 135x18 design-system fragment (the "100" + coin row already implemented inside the bet-amount field), not a screen. 9137-12640 is 1080x1350 - a social-asset aspect, not a viewport - and is purple-gradient/orange-ball promo art in another product's visual language entirely, not SKAI's green-coal/sky-blue; it is borrowed reference art. 9137-10219 is a rival auto panel using "Risk: Low/Medium/High", the retired vocabulary that the three Mode frames (named Easy/Medium/Hard) and the canonical panel 9104-6170 (labelled "Difficulty") both supersede; the same retired segment appears on 9003-82836, 9003-83784 and 9137-11578 and is deliberately not reproduced anywhere. The five furniture frames 9003-72412 Directory, 9003-72420 Rectangle 147 and 9003-72418/72421/72423 Breakpoint are canvas scaffolding. ★ MIS-TITLED, KEPT: 9137-11578 is catalogued "Skai > Play > Casino > Dice Mobile (375 x 812px)" but is neither Dice nor 812 tall - it is a genuine Plinko mobile page at 375x1605 with correct Plinko copy. Fix the title upstream. ★ WHAT KEEPS THIS OFF `done`. No render/DOM measurement was taken this pass, so every verdict in vverify.plinko.tsv is source-verified only. The tablet and mobile tier draws the CTA ABOVE the fields with the board above the panel - the same inversion Mines ships at mobile, and a real device-tier difference - while the route still renders one left-panel layout at every width. Both tablet frames carry leftover Crash/Blackjack details-card copy, so the page furniture below the game cannot be built from them as drawn. ★ WHAT WAS ALREADY RIGHT AND IS UNTOUCHED: the detail page IS built and routed (/play/plinko -> PlinkoPage + PlinkoPageSections, same widget as the modal at variant=fullscreen), and the bucket VALUES match the frames element-for-element (Easy 16-row = 16x 9x 2x 1.4x 1.4x 1.2x 1.1x 1x 0.5x mirrored; Medium = 110x 41x 10x 5x 3x 1.5x 1x 0.5x 0.3x mirrored; Hard = 1K 130x 26x 9x 4x 2x 0.2x x5 mirrored), RE-VERIFIED THIS PASS by parsing both files: PlinkoGame.tsx and PlinkoTypes.ts:47 agree on all 9 risk/row tables with zero mismatches, and every row is symmetric about its centre - which independently corroborates that a MIRRORED colour ramp is the right model for the board. The other three copies (points-game:195, game-settlement:2488, and the Go chain plinkoBPS in gaming_settle_models.go:612) are carried over from the earlier audit and were NOT re-parsed this pass. Bucket selection is server-authoritative on both live rails; the client Math.random path is cosmetic and discarded before payout. Casino settles on POINTS, so an empty on-chain bet table is correct here, not a defect. ★ CAVEAT 1 (unchanged, still open): a SIXTH copy in gridGamesService.ts:753 has low/12 wrong in 11 of 13 buckets (31.2% edge vs the canonical 1.02%) and mints serverSeed in the browser - it is dead, and must never be wired up. ★ CAVEAT 2 (unchanged, still open): PlinkoGame.test.ts declares CLIENT_MULTIPLIERS and SERVER_MULTIPLIERS as two hardcoded literals INSIDE the test and compares them to each other, importing neither real source - exactly how the gridGames divergence survived. No _shared/plinko.ts exists, unlike every other game. ★ ACCESSIBILITY, shipped as-drawn and flagged for a designer decision: all 51 buckets across the three frames print #001615, including the deep centre stops, so the luminance-based white-text switch was removed. #001615 on Hard's #9744D5 measures about 2.8:1, under WCAG AA for 11px bold. ★ 2026-08-05 THE THREE PER-DIFFICULTY RAMPS ARE VERIFIED RENDERING, by sampling the live canvas rather than by reading source. /play/plinko loaded at 1440 (600x500 canvas, 1:1 backing store), and the bucket row was pixel-sampled at nine x positions across y = 0.92h after clicking each difficulty. Easy: #7dd4e7 #57b8e6 ... #0078e6 (centre) ... #57b8e6 #7dd4e7. Medium: #8ed639 #67c334 ... #1a9627 ... #67c334 #8ed639. Hard: #db85ee #c771e7 ... #9744d5 ... #c771e7 #db85ee. Every sampled stop is a literal member of that difficulty's PLINKO_BUCKET_RAMPS array, the three sets are disjoint, and each row is symmetric about the centre bucket (position 0 == 8, 1 == 7, 3 == 5) - which confirms BOTH fixes at once: the ramps are genuinely per-difficulty (Medium and Hard no longer paint the Easy colourway) and they are mirrored edge-to-centre rather than running monotonically and colour-inverting the right half. Difficulty switching repaints immediately. Stays partial: the tablet/mobile tier is still unbuilt and the peg/ball geometry has not been render-measured.
